name: Apple Daiquiri
description: Light rum, apple juice and lime form a crisp shaken sour with a small measure of superfine sugar.
preparation: Fill a shaker one-third full with ice.
Add the light rum, apple juice, lime juice and superfine sugar.
Shake well, then pass through a strainer into a pre-chilled cocktail glass.

name: Apple Martini
description: Vodka, Cointreau and sour apple schnapps, stirred and strained cold.
preparation: Stir the schnapps, Cointreau and vodka over ice in a mixing glass.
Strain into the chilled glass.
Garnish with the apple slice.

name: Bay Breeze
description: Vodka, cranberry juice and pineapple juice served over ice with a lime wedge.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in the vodka, then the cranberry and pineapple juice.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

name: Black Russian
description: Coffee liqueur and vodka make a brisk, spirit-led drink with a roasted edge.
preparation: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Add the coffee liqueur and vodka in the recorded proportions.
Stir gently, then serve at once.

name: Boulevardier
description: Bourbon, Campari and red vermouth, stirred over ice.
preparation: Add the bourbon, Campari and vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until cold.
Strain into the chilled glass.
Garnish with citrus zest.

name: Brandy Alexander
description: Cognac and chocolate liqueur with cream, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Put the cognac, chocolate liqueur and cream in a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the chilled glass.
Sprinkle a pinch of nutmeg on top.

name: Cape Codder
description: Vodka and cranberry juice served over ice with lime.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in the vodka and cranberry juice.
Finish with the lime wedge.

name: Cuba Libre
description: Light rum, lime juice and cola built over ice.
preparation: Pack a tall glass with ice.
Add the rum and lime juice, then top with the cola.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

name: Daiquiri
description: Light rum, lime and sugar syrup, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Add the rum, syrup and lime to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the cocktail glass.

name: Derby Daiquiri
description: A frozen blend of light rum, lime, orange and sugar, served in a champagne flute.
preparation: Measure the light rum, lime juice, orange juice and sugar into a blender.
Add the instruction-specified 1/2 cup of shaved ice.
Process at low speed until icy and combined.
Pour into a champagne flute and serve.

name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
description: Rum, lime, mint, ice and sugar make a cooling blended single-serving drink.
preparation: Place the light rum, lime juice, mint, ice and sugar in a blender.
Blend to a smooth, frosty texture.
Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri
description: Light rum, pineapple, lime, ice and sugar blend into a cold, fruit-forward frozen drink.
preparation: Add the light rum, lime juice, pineapple chunks, ice and sugar to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Gin and Tonic
description: Gin meets chilled tonic in a brisk, bitter-leaning long drink finished with lime.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in the gin and top with tonic water.
Finish with the lime-peel twist and serve.

name: Gin Fizz
description: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup make a bright, lightly sparkling highball finished with club soda.
preparation: Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice.
Pour the shaken mixture into a highball glass over two ice cubes.
Gently add the club soda and stir.
Use mint, lime and/or nutmeg as an optional garnish, then serve.

name: Last Word
description: Equal parts gin, green chartreuse, maraschino and lime, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Add the four equal measures to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the cocktail glass.

name: Madras
description: Cranberry and orange juice with vodka over ice, finished with a lime wedge.
preparation: Pour the vodka, cranberry juice and orange juice over ice in a highball glass.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

name: Margarita
description: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice, shaken and strained.
preparation: Chill a cocktail glass and coat its rim with salt.
Add tequila, Cointreau and lime juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake to chill, then strain into the prepared glass.

name: Mimosa
description: Chilled orange juice and champagne make a light sparkling pour for a flute.
preparation: Pour the chilled orange juice into a champagne flute.
Ease in the chilled champagne without shaking.
Serve immediately.

name: Mojito
description: Light rum, mint, lime and soda create a fresh sparkling highball with a softly sweet edge.
preparation: Press the mint with lime juice and sugar syrup at the base of the glass.
Pack the glass with ice and add the light rum.
Top with club soda, stirring gently to lift the mint.
Use the two lime wedges as an optional garnish, then serve.

name: Negroni
description: Equal measures of gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice.
preparation: Put ice in an old-fashioned glass.
Add the gin, Campari and sweet vermouth.
Stir until cold and finish with the orange slice.

name: Paloma
description: Tequila topped with grapefruit soda and lime, served over ice with salt.
preparation: Pour the tequila and lime juice over ice in a highball glass.
Add the salt.
Top with the grapefruit soda.
Stir gently and garnish with the lime slice.

name: Pina Colada
description: White rum, cream of coconut and pineapple juice blended with crushed ice.
preparation: Blend the rum, cream of coconut and pineapple juice with crushed ice.
Blend until thick and smooth, adding more ice if needed.
Pour into a hurricane glass and garnish.

name: Rum and Coke
description: Light rum and cola make a chilled highball with a lemon accent.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in the light rum and top with cola.
Garnish with the lemon wedge and serve.

name: Rum Screwdriver
description: Light rum and orange juice make an easy chilled highball.
preparation: Put ice into a highball glass.
Pour in the light rum, then fill with orange juice.
Stir well and serve.

name: Salty Dog
description: Vodka and grapefruit juice over ice in a salt-rimmed glass.
preparation: Coat a highball glass rim with salt.
Fill the glass with ice, then pour in the vodka.
Top with the grapefruit juice.
Garnish with a citrus wedge.

name: Screwdriver
description: A familiar vodka-and-orange highball built over ice for an easy, citrus-forward serve.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the vodka, then pour in the orange juice in its recorded two-to-one proportion.
Garnish with the orange slice and serve.

name: Sidecar
description: Cognac, Triple Sec and lemon juice, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Add the cognac, triple sec and lemon juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the cocktail glass.

name: Stinger
description: Brandy and white creme de menthe make a cold, mint-accented after-dinner cocktail.
preparation: Add the brandy and white creme de menthe to a shaker with ice.
Shake until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a cocktail glass and serve.

name: Strawberry Daiquiri
description: Light rum with strawberries, lime and sugar syrup, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Muddle the strawberries with the syrup in a shaker.
Add the rum, lime juice and ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the cocktail glass.

name: Tom Collins #2
description: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup form a brisk highball, completed with club soda.
preparation: Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice.
Strain into a serving glass.
Add the recorded club soda and stir gently.
Serve immediately.

name: Vodka Gimlet
description: Vodka and lime juice with sugar, shaken and served straight up.
preparation: Add the vodka, lime juice and powdered sugar to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the cocktail glass.

name: Whiskey Highball
description: Blended whiskey and club soda make a chilled, easy-drinking highball with a lime wedge.
preparation: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the blended whiskey and top with club soda.
Stir well, garnish with the lime wedge and serve.

name: Whiskey Sour
description: Bourbon, lemon juice and sugar syrup, shaken and strained with an optional egg white.
preparation: Add the bourbon, syrup, lemon juice and optional egg white to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Strain into the sour glass.
Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry.

name: White Lady
description: Gin, Cointreau and lemon juice, shaken and strained cold.
preparation: Add the gin, Cointreau and lemon juice to a shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake hard.
Strain into the chilled glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: White Russian
description: Vodka and coffee liqueur finished with cream.
preparation: Put ice in an old-fashioned glass.
Pour in the coffee liqueur and vodka.
Float the cream on top, then stir gently.

name: Easy Blood Orange Mocktail
description: Blood orange and lime juice with alcohol-free rosé, stirred over ice.
ingredients: 1 cup alcohol free Rosé or alternative (see notes)
preparation: Fill a wine glass with ice and press in a blood orange slice.
Add the blood orange juice and lime juice with the alcohol-free rosé (or alternative), then stir gently.
Garnish with a fresh herb sprig.

ingredientDetails.raw: 1 cup alcohol free Rosé or alternative (see notes)
ingredientDetails.name: alcohol free Rosé or alternative (see notes)

garnish: Sprig of rosemary, thyme or mint

name: Quick Coconut Water Mocktail
description: Coconut water and citrus shaken with honey, with optional vinegar, Tajín rim and dehydrated citrus.
ingredients: 2 oz orange juice ((freshly squeezed is best))
1/2 teaspoon apple cider vinegar ((optional - see note 1) )
1 teaspoon honey ((or your choice of sweetener - see note 2))
preparation: Optionally rim a glass with Tajín, then fill it with ice.
Shake the measured liquids and honey with ice for about 10 to 15 seconds; include the optional apple cider vinegar if using.
Strain into the prepared glass, add optional dehydrated citrus, and serve.

ingredientDetails.raw: 2 oz orange juice ((freshly squeezed is best))
ingredientDetails.name: orange juice ((freshly squeezed is best))

ingredientDetails.raw: 1/2 teaspoon apple cider vinegar ((optional - see note 1) )
ingredientDetails.name: apple cider vinegar ((optional - see note 1) )

ingredientDetails.raw: 1 teaspoon honey ((or your choice of sweetener - see note 2))
ingredientDetails.name: honey ((or your choice of sweetener - see note 2))

name: Fig Mocktails with Apple
description: A still apple-and-fig drink with lemon, ginger, and cinnamon, served after shaking.
ingredients: 1 ripe fresh fig ((plus extra for optional garnish))
1/2 tablespoon fig jam ((optional but does add a little extra flavor and mouthfeel))
1/2 oz cinnamon syrup ((can sub with a pinch of cinnamon powder, see Note 1))
preparation: Cut the fresh fig into quarters and put it in a shaker with lemon juice, cinnamon syrup or its cinnamon alternative, and optional fig jam.
Use a muddler to break the fruit down well.
Combine the ginger, cider, and ice in the shaker, then shake with the lid on.
Fine strain into the serving glass; a piece of fig is an optional finish.

ingredientDetails.raw: 1 ripe fresh fig ((plus extra for optional garnish))
ingredientDetails.name: ripe fresh fig ((plus extra for optional garnish))

ingredientDetails.raw: 1/2 tablespoon fig jam ((optional but does add a little extra flavor and mouthfeel))
ingredientDetails.name: fig jam ((optional but does add a little extra flavor and mouthfeel))

ingredientDetails.raw: 1/2 oz cinnamon syrup ((can sub with a pinch of cinnamon powder, see Note 1))
ingredientDetails.name: cinnamon syrup ((can sub with a pinch of cinnamon powder, see Note 1))

name: Grapefruit MartiNO Mocktail
description: Grapefruit juice and rosemary syrup with aquafaba, shaken and poured cold.
preparation: Add the grapefruit juice, rosemary syrup and aquafaba to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake hard until cold.
Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Hibiscus Electrolyte Drink
description: Chilled hibiscus tea and coconut water over ice, brightened with pineapple and mineral salt.
ingredients: Splash of pineapple juice to sweeten ((or to taste))
Something to sweeten if you wish ((either more pineapple juice, honey, maple, your choice of sweetener))
Pineapple fronds, lime and/or hibiscus flowers ((optional garnishes))
preparation: Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in the chilled hibiscus tea and coconut water, then add pineapple juice and a pinch of mineral salt.
Add more pineapple juice or a sweetener of choice if wanted, then stir to combine.
Finish with optional pineapple fronds, lime, or hibiscus flowers and serve.

ingredientDetails.raw: Splash of pineapple juice to sweeten ((or to taste))
ingredientDetails.name: Splash of pineapple juice to sweeten ((or to taste))

ingredientDetails.raw: Something to sweeten if you wish ((either more pineapple juice, honey, maple, your choice of sweetener))
ingredientDetails.name: Something to sweeten if you wish ((either more pineapple juice, honey, maple, your choice of sweetener))

ingredientDetails.raw: Pineapple fronds, lime and/or hibiscus flowers ((optional garnishes))
ingredientDetails.name: Pineapple fronds, lime and/or hibiscus flowers ((optional garnishes))

garnish: Pineapple fronds, lime, or hibiscus flowers (optional)

name: Lemon Mocktails
description: Lemon, mint, coconut water and soda water stirred over ice, with optional honey.
preparation: Muddle the lemon rounds and mint in a glass, adding the optional honey if using.
Add plenty of ice, then pour in the coconut water and soda water.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Perfect Paloma Mocktails
description: Grapefruit and lime with maple, salt and a sharp optional alternative, finished with optional soda.
ingredients: 1 ounce lime juice ((squeezed fresh is best))
1/2 ounce maple syrup ((or your choice of sweetener - see Note 1))
1/4 teaspoon apple cider vinegar ((or non-alcoholic tequila - see Note 2))
1/2 cup plain or grapefruit soda ((optional - see Note 3))
preparation: Optionally rim a glass with salt or Tajín, then fill it with ice.
Shake the grapefruit juice, lime juice, maple syrup or another sweetener, apple cider vinegar or non-alcoholic tequila, and sea salt with ice until cold.
Strain into the prepared glass.
Top with the optional plain or grapefruit soda, stir gently, and serve.

ingredientDetails.name: lime juice ((squeezed fresh is best))

ingredientDetails.raw: 1/2 ounce maple syrup ((or your choice of sweetener - see Note 1))

name: Piña Colada Mocktail (Non-Alcoholic + 3 Ingredients!)
description: Frozen pineapple and coconut cream blended with pineapple juice.
preparation: Blend the frozen pineapple, coconut cream, pineapple juice and the optional non-alcoholic rum until smooth.
Pour into a glass and garnish with the pineapple wedge.

name: Pineapple Spritzer Mocktail
description: Pineapple, coconut milk and lime blended smooth, topped with sparkling water.
preparation: Blend the pineapple, coconut milk and lime juice until smooth.
Divide between two glasses.
Top with the sparkling water and serve.

name: Cranberry Mocktail With 3 Ingredients
description: Cranberry and orange juices with ginger beer over ice, with optional alcohol-free rum and garnish choices.
ingredients: 4 oz ginger beer ((sub with use ginger kombucha for a nourishing twist!))
1 oz non-alcoholic rum or spirit of choice ((optional - tastes great without))
Cranberries, orange, rosemary, thyme ((for optional garnish))
preparation: Fill a glass or mug with ice.
Add the measured cranberry and orange juices with ginger beer; include the optional non-alcoholic rum or spirit if using.
Stir gently, taste, and adjust with extra juice or ginger beer if wanted.
Finish with any of the optional cranberry, orange, rosemary or thyme garnishes.

ingredientDetails.raw: 4 oz ginger beer ((sub with use ginger kombucha for a nourishing twist!))
ingredientDetails.name: ginger beer ((sub with use ginger kombucha for a nourishing twist!))

ingredientDetails.raw: 1 oz non-alcoholic rum or spirit of choice ((optional - tastes great without))
ingredientDetails.name: non-alcoholic rum or spirit of choice ((optional - tastes great without))

ingredientDetails.raw: Cranberries, orange, rosemary, thyme ((for optional garnish))
ingredientDetails.name: Cranberries, orange, rosemary, thyme ((for optional garnish))

name: Easy Roy Rogers Drink
description: Cola and grenadine over ice in a tall glass, garnished with maraschino cherries.
preparation: Pack a tall glass with ice.
Add the grenadine, then top with the cola.
Stir the drink well.
Garnish with one or two maraschino cherries.

name: The Best Shirley Temple Mocktail
description: A fizzy lime-and-grenadine build over ice, with an optional maraschino cherry.
preparation: Fill a glass with ice.
Combine the ginger ale with grenadine and a squeeze of fresh lime, then stir gently.
Add an optional maraschino cherry garnish and serve.

name: Virgin Mango Margarita
description: A blended mango, coconut water and lime mocktail.
preparation: Blend the frozen mango, coconut water and lime juice until smooth.
Pour into a salt-rimmed glass and finish with a lime wheel.

name: Vodka Mocktail
description: Apple and lemon juice with alcohol-free vodka, shaken and strained.
ingredients: 1 ounce alcohol free vodka or 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
preparation: Add the apple juice, lemon juice, alcohol-free vodka and the optional sugar or sweetener to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until combined.
Pour into the martini glass.
Garnish with an apple fan.

ingredientDetails.raw: 1 ounce alcohol free vodka or 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
ingredientDetails.name: alcohol free vodka or 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar

name: Watermelon Strawberry Mocktail
description: Watermelon and strawberries blended with fresh lime juice.
preparation: Blend the watermelon, strawberries and lime juice together.
Pour over ice to serve.
